summary.en: Commerzbank used Gemini 1.5 Pro to automate client call documentation, reducing processing from 60+ minutes to a few minutes.

overview.en: Commerzbank, a leading German bank, implemented an AI agent powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro to automate the documentation of client calls. The multi-stage architecture on Vertex AI diarizes transcripts with speaker identification, extracts relevant facts, and generates multiple German-language summaries tailored to specific domain requirements using chain-of-thought prompting. What previously took 60+ minutes can now be completed in just a few minutes, freeing financial advisors to focus on building client relationships and providing personalized advice.

en: Automated client call documentation using Gemini 1.5 Pro on Vertex AI.
Processing time reduced from 60+ minutes to just a few minutes.
System generates diarized transcripts with speaker identification.
Produces compliant, domain-specific summaries using chain-of-thought prompting.
Financial advisors freed to focus on higher-value client relationship activities.
zh: 在 Vertex AI 上使用 Gemini 1.5 Pro 自動化客戶通話文件記錄。
處理時間從 60 分鐘以上縮短至數分鐘。

overview.en: Deutsche Bank built DB Lumina, an AI-powered research tool on Google Cloud using Gemini 2.0/2.5 and Vertex AI. Compresses research report creation from hours or days to minutes.

Maintains stringent data privacy standards required by financial regulations.

overview.en: HSBC needed compliant, multimarket, and multilingual marketing that delivered the right message at the right time to the right customer.
